claude_only.name: Which identifier scheme designates this decision, and which body governs and issues values in that scheme?
Does the identifier designate the decision act, the record documenting it, or both, and how is the other one identified?
When an authoritative master-system number, a governed global identifier and a locally minted UUID/ULID all exist, which is canonical for citation and which are aliases?
How is an identifier minted for a decision taken without a meeting, a case number or a hearing — for example a delegated sign-off or unanimous written consent?
Are any date-bearing tokens inside the identifier being relied on as the decision date, and if so how is that dependency removed?
At which identity level does each stored item sit — abstract decision (work), a specific version or language (expression), a format (manifestation), or a single file (item)?
Which expression is the authentic or authoritative text, and what governs divergence between language versions?
When a text is corrected, is a new expression created or is the existing one edited, and how is the superseded expression preserved?
Does an anonymised or redacted published expression exist alongside a full internal expression, and are they explicitly linked?

Which decision family does this record belong to — administrative decision, judicial judgment, corporate resolution, delegated approval, gate or change approval, or retained machine authorization decision?
Is the instrument binding, or is it an opinion, recommendation or advice that does not itself dispose of the matter?
Is this an interim, partial, recommended or final decision, and if not final what does it leave undecided?
Where an external decision vocabulary is used, is it the canonical classification or an alignment, and what does not map?
What subject matter does the decision concern, and against which classification scheme is that subject expressed?
Does the decision bind only named addressees, or does it apply generally to a class of persons, cases or objects?
Which jurisdiction, territory or organisational unit does the decision operate in, and is its effect limited to that boundary?
Is the decision intended to have precedential or policy effect beyond the instant matter, and who may rely on it?
What exact question, motion or proposal was put, and in what wording was it put to the deciding body?
What triggered the decision — an application, a referral, a statutory duty, a scheduled review or an own-initiative act — and who initiated it?
Which stakeholder concerns, requirements or criteria was the decision required to address?
Was the question amended, split or reframed before decision, and is the final wording distinguishable from the original?
What is the operative outcome value, and from which controlled vocabulary is it drawn?
How are non-dispositive results represented — deferral, adjournment, withdrawal, no quorum, tie, not applicable or unable to determine?
Which part of the record is the operative determination, and which parts are reasoning that does not bind?
Where the decision grants in part and refuses in part, how is each element of relief and refusal separately expressed?
If an external four-valued authorization vocabulary is used, which administrative outcomes have no equivalent and how is that recorded?
Which conditions must be satisfied before the decision takes effect, and which conditions if breached end its effect?
Which attached requirements are binding obligations that must be discharged and which are advice that may be disregarded without invalidating the outcome?
Who is responsible for implementing and enforcing the decision, and what happens if it is not implemented?
Is effectiveness deliberately deferred to a later date or a future event, and is there a maximum permitted deferral?
Is there a legal or policy duty to give reasons for this decision, and what instrument imposes it?
Do the reasons address all material issues of fact, law and discretion presented, and how is that completeness checked?
Are the reasons part of the operative instrument, an annexed statement, or a separately requestable document?
Where reasons are abbreviated, standardised or omitted, what justifies that and is a fuller statement available on request?
Which alternatives were formally considered, and is the list complete relative to what the deciding body was given?
Against which criteria and weights were the alternatives assessed, and were those criteria fixed before assessment?
For each rejected alternative, what is the recorded reason for rejection?
Was the status quo or 'take no action' option explicitly assessed, and on what basis was it set aside?
Which specific inputs did the decision-maker use, and are they retained and resolvable at the version actually relied upon?
What facts were found, and which input supports each finding?
Was the affected party heard before an adverse measure, and what submissions were received and considered?
For machine-evaluated inputs, which attribute sources supplied values and were any required attributes missing?
Which body, office or role took the decision, as distinct from anyone who prepared, recommended or merely signed it?
Which instrument and provision confer competence to take this decision, and was it in force at the decision time?
What composition, quorum or qualification rules applied to the deciding body, and what is their source?
How is it verified that the decision falls within the conferred competence, and what happens if it does not?
Who delegated the power, to whom, and is there a sub-delegation chain back to the original holder of competence?
What monetary, categorical or risk thresholds bound the delegated power, and does this decision fall inside them?
Which matters are expressly excluded from delegation and reserved to the delegating body?
Was the delegation in force at the decision time, and had it been revoked, suspended or lapsed?
Was quorum required and met, counted against which denominator, and who determined that?
How were votes cast and counted — in favour, against, abstaining, absent — and what majority did the outcome require?
If the decision was taken without a meeting, how was consent collected, when did it become effective, and where is it filed?
Did any participant attend by remote communication, and does the governing rule count that as presence?
Where approval is multi-step, were the steps sequential or parallel, and was any step skipped, escalated or auto-approved on timeout?
Did any participant dissent or issue a separate opinion, and is that text part of the published record?
Did any eligible participant recuse themselves, on what stated ground, and at what point in the process?
What conflicts of interest were declared, by whom, and how were they managed?
What control detects an undeclared conflict after the decision, and what remedy applies if one is found?
Who signed or sealed the record, in what capacity, and with what kind of signature or seal?
Is there a third-party attested time of existence for the record content, and how does it differ from the asserted signing time?
Which content was hashed, with which algorithm, and does the digest cover the reasons and annexes as well as the operative part?
When was verification last performed, by whom, with what verdict, and what is the re-verification interval?
At which lifecycle point does the record become unalterable, and what mechanism enforces that?
Which distinct times exist for this decision, and which one is the authoritative 'decision time' for citation and for computing deadlines?
Are the time the event occurred and the time it was recorded or ingested stored separately, and how far apart are they?
Does every stored time carry an explicit UTC offset or Z, and how is an unknown local offset represented?
For action taken by consent rather than at a sitting, what rule fixes the moment the decision was taken?
When was the decision served on or notified to each addressee, and does that start a challenge period?
From when until when is the decision valid, and is the end open, fixed, conditional or event-driven?
Does the decision take effect from a date earlier than it was taken, and what authorises that retroactivity?
Can validity be suspended without being ended, and what events suspend and restore it?
Is the decision renewable or subject to periodic review, and does renewal create a new decision or extend this one?
How does a consumer ask whether the decision was valid at a specific past instant, and what does the answer depend on?
What is the complete set of permitted states, and which are terminal?
Which transitions are permitted, who may trigger each, and what preconditions guard them?
When does the decision become final in the substantive sense — no longer open to ordinary challenge — and is that different from the record becoming unalterable?
At what point does a draft or proposed decision become a record subject to management, and how are pre-record drafts handled?
Which operations remain permitted after finality, and how is each recorded without altering the fixed content?
Which change type applies — corrigendum to the text, amendment to the substance, replacement by a new decision, or revocation without replacement?
Which decision replaces this one and which does this one replace, expressed as explicit bidirectional links?
Does the change affect the whole decision or only identified parts, and does the remainder stay in force?
Who is competent to revoke or amend this decision, and must it be the same or a higher authority?
From when does the change take effect, and does it disturb acts already taken in reliance on the original?
What challenge routes exist — internal review, administrative appeal, judicial review, ombudsman — and which apply to this decision?
What is the time limit for challenge, from which event does it run, and can it be extended?
Does lodging a challenge suspend the decision's effect, and if not can suspension be requested separately?
How is the outcome of a challenge recorded — upheld, varied, quashed, remitted — and does it alter, replace or annul the original?
Where a decision is annulled, does the annulment operate from the original date or only from the annulment, and what happens to acts done meanwhile?
Which case, matter, project or programme contains this decision, and is containment exclusive?
Was the decision produced at a meeting or by a consent process, and which agenda item or consent round does it correspond to?
Which other decisions does this one implement, rely on, cite, contradict or depend on for its validity?
What happens when a linked decision is revoked, annulled or destroyed under a retention rule — is this decision's validity affected?
Who are the formal addressees of the decision, and how are they identified authoritatively rather than by name alone?
Which parties are affected without being addressees, and do they acquire procedural rights such as being heard or challenging?
Which objects does the decision operate on, and are they identified at a specific version or state?
Does the decision produce legal or similarly significant effects on a natural person, and does that trigger additional safeguards?
Was the decision human-made, system-assisted or based solely on automated processing, and who assessed that classification?
Which system, model or rule engine produced or recommended the result, at which version and configuration?
Which policy, rule set or decision logic was applied, and is that exact version retained and retrievable?
What execution logs were generated, what do they contain, and for how long are they kept?
Where a human signed off a system-generated result, was that review substantive enough to displace 'solely automated' status?
What human oversight measures applied, who exercised them, and did the overseer have authority and competence to change the outcome?
What explanation of the logic and of the significance and consequences is owed and provided to the affected person?
How can the affected person obtain human intervention, express a point of view and contest the decision, and what are the time limits?
Were any overrides of the system result recorded, by whom and on what stated ground?
Is there a duty to publish, a duty to notify addressees individually, or both, and what instrument imposes each?
Through which channel and register was the decision published or served, and in which language versions?
What proof exists that each addressee received the decision, and what is the deemed-service rule where receipt is unproven?
What happens if publication or notification fails or is late — does the decision still take effect, and does the challenge clock still run?
What access classification applies to the record as a whole, and do any parts carry a stricter classification?
How does an affected party exercise the right to access their own file, and what may legitimately be withheld from them?
Which content must be redacted or anonymised before disclosure, on what basis, and who performs and approves the redaction?
Are deliberative materials — draft reasoning, internal advice, vote-level detail — withheld while the operative decision is disclosed, and under what rule?
Which event starts the retention period — creation, issuance, expiry of validity, exhaustion of challenge routes or closure of the containing case?
Which disposition authority or schedule governs this record, and what disposition outcome does it prescribe?
Is any disposal hold in force, who applied it, on what basis, and when is it reviewed?
When disposal or transfer is executed, what evidence of it is retained after the record itself is gone?
Does the decision have enduring evidential, precedential or historical value that requires permanent retention or archival transfer?
Which external identifier schemes apply to this decision, and is each one authoritative, an alias or merely advisory?
Which external vocabularies is the record projected into for exchange, and which internal elements have no target?
Which mappings are lossy or semantically inexact, and how is that recorded so a consumer is not misled?
Is conformance to any external standard claimed, and what evidence supports the claim?
Can an exported projection be re-imported without loss of identity, versioning or attestation, and what is lost if not?

grok_only.name: What identifier does the authoritative originating system assign to this decision record, and which system is the master?
What governed global identifier or IRI is published for interchange if the record is shared beyond the master system?
If no master or governed IRI exists, what UUID or ULID did the adopting Dimension assign, and when was it assigned?
What local sequential or classified decision number is used for human citation, and has that number been retired rather than reused after supersession?
What short title names this decision in terms of the problem solved and the outcome chosen?
In which language or languages is the authoritative text of the decision expressed?
What alternative names, docket numbers or popular citations should retrieve the same record without becoming identifiers?
Is the recorded act an approval, denial, conditional approval, deferral, revocation, stay, vacatur, or another controlled outcome kind?
Is this an architectural, administrative-adjudicative, operational, corporate, or other domain kind of decision?
Does this record an authorised instance, or is the user actually describing reusable DMN decision logic that belongs in a sibling model?
What case, request, design problem, asset, licence, person or other subject does this decision bind?
Which legal or organisational jurisdiction is the source of the power being exercised?
Where, to whom and to which systems or territories does the decision apply, and are there explicit out-of-scope exclusions?
What problem or question was the decision required to resolve, stated without arguing for the chosen option?
Which legal, technical, political, financial, safety or other drivers constrained the choice?
Which material issues of fact, law or discretion were presented on the record and therefore require a ruling?
Which options were considered, including the option to do nothing or to defer?
What advantages and disadvantages were recorded for each option?
Which options were eliminated by a knock-out driver, and which driver eliminated them?
What is the operative text of the decision or approval, stated as an action rather than as a discussion?
What specific relief, licence, change, expenditure, design choice or sanction is granted, denied or ordered?
Is the outcome full, partial or conditional, and which parts of the request remain undecided?
What findings of fact were made, and on which evidence does each finding rest?
What conclusions of law or discretion were reached, and what reasons or basis support each conclusion?
What ruling was recorded on each proposed finding, conclusion or exception submitted by a party?
Why was the chosen option selected against the recorded drivers, including any knock-out criterion?
What conditions precedent, subsequent or continuing must be satisfied for the approval to take or keep effect?
What quantitative, temporal, geographic or use limitations restrict the grant?
What positive, negative and neutral consequences were recorded as the resulting context after the decision?
Which agents are the decision-makers or approvers, and is each a person, organisation or software agent?
Who was consulted, who was merely informed, and who recorded or registered the decision?
If a system or model produced the outcome, which human or organisation remains responsible, and is that attribution explicit?
What statute, charter, policy, licence or delegation instrument authorised this agent to make this class of decision?
On whose behalf did the deciding agent act, and is the delegation current, limited or expired?
If the decision was collective, what quorum applied, what was the vote tally, and were abstentions or dissents recorded?
Was a second-person confirmation or segregation of duties required, and is that requirement sourced from local policy rather than this model?
Did any otherwise-eligible decider recuse, and what conflict or interest was disclosed?
From what time did ex parte prohibitions apply for this proceeding, and did any person have prior knowledge that a hearing would be noticed?
What is the current status of this decision record in the proposed–accepted–rejected–deprecated–superseded vocabulary, and are any local extensions in use?
What prior statuses did the record pass through, who changed each status, and at what event time versus ingestion time?
Has the operative text been edited after acceptance, or was a superseding record created instead?
Is this an initial, recommended, tentative or final agency decision, or does that grading not apply?
Did the deciding body preside at the reception of the evidence, and if not, who is the presiding or recommending employee?
Was the recommended or tentative decision omitted because the agency found on the record that due and timely execution of its functions imperatively and unavoidably required it?
At what date-time did the decision act occur, with seconds and explicit offset or Z?
At what date-time was this record observed, ingested or registered, and is that different from the decision event?
When was the instrument issued, and when was it accepted or last modified as a resource?
From when does the decision take legal or operational effect, and is that time different from issuance?
Until when does the decision remain valid, including any sunset, expiry or stated review date?
Is effect claimed before the decision event time, and which local authority permits that retroactivity?
Is the decision currently in force given now, its validity window, stays and supersession?
Which later decision record supersedes or replaces this one, and which earlier records does this one replace?
Has an appeal or agency review been taken, within what time, on which issues, and with what result?
Is the effect stayed, remanded or vacated, and does the underlying record remain as evidence?
If the decision entity was invalidated, at what time and by which activity did invalidation occur?
Which activity generated this decision record, and over what interval did that activity run?
Which evidence, submissions, prior decisions, models or other entities were used in making the decision?
From which prior records or drafts is this record derived or revised, and is a PROV bundle available for those assertions?
Which meeting, hearing or proceeding produced this decision, and what is that activity's identifier?
What extract of minutes, transcript or docket shows the motion, vote or ruling?
Was the decision first given orally and only later memorialised, and is contemporaneous capture incomplete?
Can it be shown that this record is what it purports to be, created or sent by the purported agent at the purported time?
What fixity or protection against unauthorised alteration is recorded, and have any authorised amendments been logged?
Can the record be located, retrieved, presented and interpreted in its business context, including persistent links to related records?
Does the record contain a ruling on every material issue and every exception presented, and which items are missing?
How will compliance with the decision be confirmed, and by whom?
Has implementation been confirmed, with what result and evidence?
What is the default access rule for this decision record, and who is the rights holder?
Does the rationale or vote record contain personal data that requires minimisation, redaction or a narrower access scope?
Which statutory or policy exceptions withhold or delay disclosure, and which bodies still have an overriding right of access?
What audit trail is required for reads, exports and failed access attempts against this record?
Which disposition authority or retention schedule class applies, for how long, and what is the trigger event?
Is the record under legal hold or other freeze that blocks destruction or transfer?
What disposition action is authorised at period end, who may perform it, and has it been carried out?
Which external profiles does this instance claim to align to, and is any conformance actually certified?
Which known mapping conflicts apply to this instance, such as date-only ADR fields or missing APA findings?
If the record is exchanged, which projection (for example PROV, DCMI, ADR template, or agency order schema) is the payload, without treating that projection as the semantics?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
